legacy_assumptions_superseded.assumption: Manager coverage may be collective across a model's concepts, and shared_grammar counts as coverage.
legacy_assumptions_superseded.what_changed: Each of concepts 05-11 demonstrates all 42 required families itself. The four core surfaces that the previous pass recorded as shared_grammar — Settings Home, Settings Search, Settings Workspace, ordinary setting grammar — are now proved by routing to them and reading the surface the concept rendered.

legacy_assumptions_superseded.assumption: Editable Global/Project/Goal/Host scope and inheritance may be shown.
legacy_assumptions_superseded.what_changed: Every editable value belongs to the current Project. No scope selector, no inheritance, no linked Projects, no profiles. The shared vocabulary used by concepts 01-04 still emits 'Inherited · <source>'; the new concepts use their own row vocabulary, which has no inherited state at all.

legacy_assumptions_superseded.assumption: A generated fixture may stand in for the settings inventory.
legacy_assumptions_superseded.what_changed: All 828 canonical records from Plans/settings_inventory.json are indexed and routable in every new concept. Synthetic volume exists only as a separately marked, off-by-default stress fixture.

legacy_assumptions_superseded.assumption: Search may route through a grouped list using visual position.
legacy_assumptions_superseded.what_changed: Routing is by immutable result id resolved to a destination object. The search-route matrix records, per case, the id clicked and the destination reached.

legacy_assumptions_superseded.assumption: The Tome, Command Suite and Tabbed Organizer visual materials may be reproduced.
legacy_assumptions_superseded.what_changed: Those three references are layout-only. Their skins are removed and rebuilt from Puppet Master theme tokens.

current_product_baseline_reviewed.data: window.PM_SETTINGS_DATA — the same 828-record inventory the new concepts consume.

the horizontally scrolling shelves, which 03_HOME_SEARCH_AND_NAVIGATION.md forbids

evidence_that_new_work_does_not_route_th.static_check: tools/harness/run.js --suites=static fails a concept whose page, script or stylesheet contains an iframe, the string opus-5-atlas/console/stack/ledger, a reference to another concept-NN page, or a call to PMManagerKit.homeOf / ASSIGNMENT / CONCEPTS / assignedTo.
evidence_that_new_work_does_not_route_th.runtime_check: the manager-route matrix crawls every manager destination in every new concept and records, per route, the rendered surface's own data-pm-manager attribute, the retained shell, and whether any cross-concept string appears anywhere in the document.
evidence_that_new_work_does_not_route_th.shared_layer_guard: shared2/pm2-managers.js refuses to call PMManagerKit.spec() for an id PMManagerKit.has() reports false for, because that path is the one that renders 'Built in another concept' with a link to opus-5-atlas.html. Every emitted spec is additionally walked and any surviving cross-concept string is rewritten to the concept's own domain destination.
evidence_that_new_work_does_not_route_th.frozen_originals: shared/** and the four original pages are untouched; the regression suite loads all four, asserts zero console errors and re-routes into a manager in each.

subsequent_passes.pass: compliance re-read of the authority files against the built concepts
subsequent_passes.why: The harness was green on every suite. This pass re-read the authority line by line and compared each named behaviour to what was on screen, on the assumption that a passing suite proves only what it was written to check.

requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.requirement: The requested subcategory/setting/manager scrolls into view.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.was: Section-level deep links landed at the top of the page; the requested group sat 1518-2285px below the fold in six of seven concepts.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.now: Each concept's reveal resolves route.sectionId and scrolls it in, instantly and container-scoped, with the arrival marker on it.

requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.requirement: Scrolling updates the active left-nav subcategory.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.was: Every concept had click-to-jump and none had scroll-to-highlight.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.now: shared2/pm2-spy.js binds the frozen headless shared/pm-sections.js; each concept paints its own highlight. A controlled jump pins the highlight until the reader's own wheel, touch or scroll key releases it.

requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.requirement: The right side is a continuous document of that category's subcategories.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.was: Concept 10's cascade put one group in the rightmost pane, so it had no continuous document and could not satisfy the scrollspy behaviour at all.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.now: Its settings pane holds the whole page; the group list beside it is the left-nav that scrolling updates; clicking a group is a controlled jump into the document.

requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.requirement: Notices separate Needs attention / Continue setup / Recommended.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.was: One toned list in every concept, which makes an unfinished setup look like a fault.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.now: PM2States.attentionGroups / attentionFlat supply the three runs; each concept draws the run labels in its own typography.

requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.requirement: Popup menus use the Model/Mode selector family including collision handling, layering, submenus, and open/close behavior.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.was: Placement, flipping, layering and Escape were built; no concept ever opened a submenu.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.now: PM2Menu.placeSide and PM2Menu.groupsFor; all seven open a submenu beside its parent, in view, Escape closing one layer.

requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.requirement: All-theme support, including the retro themes' snap.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.was: Menus are appended to document.body, outside each concept's root, so the root-scoped retro snap never reached them: animationDuration measured 0.12s in all seven under retro-dark.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.now: The snap rule names the menu classes explicitly; measured 0s in all seven.

requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.requirement: All-theme support, including the two glass palettes.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.was: Menus set no backdrop filter while --pm-surface-2 is rgba(...,.68) in the glass themes, so page text read through the panel.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.now: backdrop-filter: var(--pm-surface-blur), the same way shared/pm-shell.css:563 solves it for the app's own popups; plus an inset hairline on an open submenu parent, because glass puts surface-3 within a few percent of surface-2.

requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.requirement: General fixtures list 'Long explanation' and 'Long localized label' separately.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.was: One combined fixture, which cannot tell a clipped name from a clipped sentence.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.now: long-label and long-explanation, each stretching only its own field. 21 fixtures in total.

requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.requirement: A result or link routes to the exact domain, page, manager, object, section or row.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.was: 633 of 786 manager roster items were unroutable; 11 of 28 sampled drill-downs landed on a not-found page. Two id vocabularies for one object, and the router treating 'not a search result' as 'does not exist'.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.now: One vocabulary, and a built spec registers what it contains with the index. 786 of 786 routable; every sampled drill-down lands.

requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.requirement: Escape closes the popup first, then moves one Settings level outward, and stops at Settings Home.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.was: One keypress did both: six of seven concepts closed the theme menu AND navigated away from the row being edited, because a concept's Escape handler sits on document in the same phase as the menu's and stopPropagation does not stop a listener already on that node. The route step also skipped two levels, going from a row straight to the domain.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.now: pm2-menu.js calls stopImmediatePropagation; every concept's backTarget has a case for a route deeper than a page. All seven walk row to page to domain to Home and stop with Settings open.

requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.requirement: A compact Needs attention list with normally two to four unresolved items.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.was: Splitting the notices into the three required groups left Needs attention holding one item and Continue setup holding three, because a non-responding MCP server and a stale search index were toned as setup.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.now: Retoned as the faults they are. Home reads 3 / 1 / 1.

requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.authority: 06_INFORMATION_ARCHITECTURE_AND_DENSITY.md / GOAL_PROMPT.md - no clipped or unreadable text
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.requirement: A setting's own name is legible at every required width.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.was: Concept 10's continuous document put a whole page in a pane sized for one group; table-layout: fixed subtracts the 208px value and 136px status columns from the name column first, leaving it around 26px, and overflow-wrap on the title let flex shrink it to zero so the name painted over the explanation beside it.
requirements_found_unmet_and_fixed.now: The settings pane is the wide one; value and status are 190px and 124px; the name cell wraps with an eight-character floor and the row height is a minimum rather than a fixed 32px; the inline explanation is drawn only at four panes, where it has room for a phrase.

also_verified_and_already_correct: Narrow navigation preserves the route, the selected item, the arrival marker, the search query and the Back destination across a collapse to 760 and back, in all seven concepts; the rail never overlays Settings content.
No concept exposes global previous/next-manager navigation.
